I thought a year ago when I bought a new laptop with 365 and Copilot integrated that they would make better use of AI... I can't think of when I actually used it and cancelled any subscription associated with it. On the other hand, I use ChatGPT all the time.

Hate that if you use Word for Mac, you now have Copilot next to your cursor with no way of turning it off. I just want to use Word... Now they're jamming AI down my throat without any opt-out mechanism.

I subscribed for a trial month... Oh boy! It couldn't do anything except append to the end of the document. It couldn't create tables! It couldn't search and replace! It couldn't maintain formatting. What a failure!
In MacOS Outlook they have a quarter inch sized bar in the main UI with just a button to summarize. It is so bad.

When CoPilot showed up in my Word, I was writing a pitch doc... It made me realize I didn't know whether this doc was getting auto-pushed to CoPilot and would be used for training in some way. Dislike.
the way it can fetch data from across documents in 365 is really good
I wish they solved basic things first not working well... wasting more time for me than I can gain with this copilot thingy.
I use AI everyday and never found a use case for Copilot.
